question: Which amendment of the Constitution of India makes Delhi a National Capital Territory (NCT)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**69th Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

69th Amendment:

__
 
• 69th Amendment Constitutional Amendment Act of 1991__ designated the Union Territory of Delhi as the National Capital Territory of Delhi. 
 
• The 69th Amendment act of the Indian Constitution granted special status to Delhi.
 
• In 1991, the amendment was passed and it granted a special state to Delhi and it was declared the National Capital Territory.
 
• It created a state assembly and council of ministers for the state. 
 
• Aditya Nath Jha became the first Lieutenant Governor of Delhi under the act.
 
• Article 239AA of the Constitution gave the status of Union Territory to Delhi.
 
• Lieutenant Governor of Delhi: Vinai Kumar Saxena
 
• Chief Minister of Delhi: Arvind Kejriwal

__Thus, by the 69th Amendment, Delhi has become the National Capital Region.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The 70th Constitutional Amendment:

 
 
• By the 70th Constitutional Amendment, the elected members of the Pondicherry Legislative Assembly were included in the electoral college of the President of India.
 
 

 
• 68th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1991:

 
 
• The President's rule in Punjab, imposed in May 1987, was extended for a period of five years through the 68th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1991.
 
• This amendment allowed the President's rule to be in force beyond the standard period as an exceptional measure due to the prevailing circumstances in Punjab at that time.
 
• The extension was considered necessary due to the ongoing insurgency and law and order situation in the state.
